question: Do you deliver to my pincode?
answerMd:
Enter your pincode in the box above, or at checkout, and we will tell you straight away whether we can deliver, and what the estimate is. This check happens before you pay.

We deliver to every pincode that has an India Post delivery post office.

question: How long will delivery take?
How much is shipping?
answerMd: Shipping is {{settings.flat_fee}} per order. It is free on orders of {{settings.free_threshold}} or more, after discounts, and always free for delivery to the MAHE Bengaluru campus. You see the shipping fee in your bag before you check out. There are no extra charges added after you place your order.

question: How do I track my order?
answerMd: When your order is handed to the courier, we email you the courier name, tracking number and a link. You can also use our [Track order](/track) page with your order reference and the email or phone number you used at checkout. You do not need an account.

question: My order is late. What should I do?
answerMd:
First check the tracking link in your dispatch email. If there is no update, write to {{settings.support_email}} with your order reference and we will check with the courier. We usually reply within {{settings.response_time}}.

{{#if settings.delay_message}}**Current delivery notice:** {{settings.delay_message}}{{/if}}

question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
answerMd: Contact us as soon as possible at {{settings.support_email}} or through the [Help page](/help), with your order reference. We can change the address only if the order has not yet been handed to the courier.

question: What if I am not home when the courier comes?
answerMd: The courier will try to deliver {{settings.policy.delivery_attempts}} time(s). Please keep your phone reachable. If delivery fails, the parcel may be sent back to us. See the failed-delivery section of our [Shipping Policy](/policies/shipping).

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answerMd: You can pay online by UPI, debit or credit card, net banking or wallet. Payments are processed securely by Razorpay.{{#if settings.cod_enabled}} Cash on Delivery is also available for eligible orders.{{/if}}

question: Is Cash on Delivery available?
answerMd: {{#if settings.cod_enabled}}Yes, for eligible orders. COD is not available for every pincode, and it is available for orders up to {{settings.cod_max_order_value}}. COD fee: {{settings.cod_fee}}. Checkout shows if COD is available for your address and order.{{else}}Not right now. You can pay online by UPI, card, net banking or wallet.{{/if}}

question: Do the prices include taxes?
answerMd: Yes. All prices on the site are in rupees and include all taxes. We never add tax on top, so the total you see in your bag and at checkout is the total you pay.

question: Is it safe to pay on your site?
answerMd: Online payments are handled by Razorpay on their secure payment page. We never see or store your card number, UPI PIN or net-banking details.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted. What now?
answerMd:
Please do not pay again straight away. When a payment fails, the money is normally reversed to your account automatically by your bank. This can take {{settings.policy.refund_bank_days}}.

If you were charged and your order was not confirmed, we also refund the amount to your original payment method. Write to {{settings.support_email}} with your order reference (or payment reference) and we will check. We start any refund within {{settings.policy.refund_initiation_days}} working days.

question: How are refunds paid?
answerMd: Prepaid orders are refunded to the same payment method. We start refunds within {{settings.policy.refund_initiation_days}} working days of approval, and your bank may take {{settings.policy.refund_bank_days}} to show it. For Cash on Delivery orders we refund by UPI or bank transfer within {{settings.policy.cod_refund_days}} working days of getting your details. See our [Returns and Refunds Policy](/policies/returns-refunds).

question: Why does my bag show a hold on items while I pay?
answerMd: To stop items selling out while you pay, we hold them for about {{settings.reservation_ttl_minutes}} minutes at checkout. If you do not complete payment in that time, the hold ends. Nothing is charged unless your payment succeeds.

question: Do I need an account to order?
answerMd: No. You can check out as a guest. An account is optional. It lets you see past orders, save addresses and keep your wishlist across devices. You sign in with a one-time code sent to your email, so there is no password to remember.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answerMd: Open your order page and choose **Cancel order**, if cancellation is still available. You can cancel while the fulfilment status is: {{settings.cancellable_statuses}}. Otherwise, contact {{settings.support_email}}. Prepaid orders are refunded automatically to the original payment method. See our [Cancellation Policy](/policies/cancellation).

question: Can I return an item?
answerMd: {{#if settings.return_policy_type == "no_returns"}}We do not accept returns for change of mind. If an item arrives damaged, defective, wrong or missing, you can report it within {{settings.damaged_claim_window_hours}} hours of delivery and we will refund or replace it. See our [Returns and Refunds Policy](/policies/returns-refunds).{{else}}Yes. You can ask to return an item within {{settings.returns_window_days}} days of delivery, subject to the conditions in our [Returns and Refunds Policy](/policies/returns-refunds). If an item arrives damaged, defective, wrong or missing, use Report a problem within {{settings.damaged_claim_window_hours}} hours of delivery.{{/if}}

question: My item arrived damaged or wrong. What do I do?
answerMd: Use **Report a problem** on your order page within {{settings.damaged_claim_window_hours}} hours of delivery. Add your order reference and clear photos of the parcel, the label and the item. We reply within {{settings.response_time}} and offer a refund or a replacement. Your legal rights do not end after this window, so contact us even if you notice a problem later.

question: How do I download my invoice?
answerMd: Open your order page and choose **Download invoice**. A copy is also attached to your order confirmation email. {{#if settings.gstin}}Our invoices are tax invoices that show our GSTIN.{{else}}Our invoices are bills of supply.{{/if}}

question: I did not get an order confirmation email.
answerMd: Check your spam or promotions folder. Then try our [Track order](/track) page with your order reference or the email you used. If you still cannot find it, contact {{settings.support_email}} and we will resend it.
